ambient_events: Three streams of filth meet at your feet and argue their way down one throat.
The brickwork groans as something upstream lets go a surge of water.
Bubbles break the surface of the channel and pop, one after another.
description: A vaulted junction where three brick channels pour into one. Corroded handrails ring a central sump grate that swallows the combined flow with a steady, hungry gurgle. Old maintenance stencils on the walls have rotted to ghost-shapes. West, a channel has caved in on itself; the rest run on into the dark.
name: The Confluence
